messages.text: Quick one, one of the chefs forgot to clock out on Friday and his shift is still showing as running. It says forty one hours.

Try this: 1. Open Hours; anything still running shows in amber with the word Open against it. 2. Click the line and type the finish time the shift actually ended at. 3. Give a reason, save, and the hours drop into the total. (From: Missed clock-outs and how to put them right)
Sorted, cheers.
Quick one, one of the managers has access to a venue she does not run.

This should sort it: This article is about what managers can see. Everything below is done from Staff, and you need to be a manager or the owner of the account to see the page at all. (From: What managers can see)
That is the wrong thing entirely. Manager can see the other site.
I am not finding a page that covers that. I will pass this to the desk and somebody will pick it up here.
Hi, Kit here from the desk. I can see the chat. That needs a change on the account which I have made for you.
Done. Thanks.
hiya, one of the team did fifty one hours and none of it has come out as overtime.

From the help centre: 1. Put contracted hours on the staff record; overtime is anything over that in a week. 2. Set the overtime rate under Settings > Pay, as a multiplier or a flat rate. 3. The overtime column on the hours page fills in as the week goes past the contract. (From: Overtime and how it is counted)
That worked, thanks.
Quick one, the receipts I have do not show a VAT number and I need them to.
I cannot make changes to billing from here, but the desk can. Passing you to the desk now; they can see this chat.
Kit on the desk, sorry about the run-around. I have done it from this end, you should see it now.
Yes that is it, thank you.
Hello, my accountant needs proper VAT invoices for the last six months.
I cannot make changes to billing from here, but the desk can. Passing you to the desk now; they can see this chat.
Rosa on the desk, sorry about the run-around. It is a known problem with the latest app version, an update is on the way; use the website until then.
Sorted, cheers.
Hello, my phone calendar has not picked up the new rota at all.
Here is what to do: What follows is our answer on calendar links and how they keep up to date. Open Settings > Connections before you start. (From: Calendar links and how they keep up to date)
That worked, thanks.
Quick one, till figures have stopped coming in and the percentage is useless without them.

This should sort it: The page for wage cost percentage on the rota is Settings > Pay. It has changed a little since last year and this article has been brought up to date with it. (From: Wage cost percentage on the rota)
That worked, thanks.
Quick one, i have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me.

From the help centre: 1. Open the staff record and tick both venues under Works at. 2. They now appear in the staff list at either site and can be dragged on to either rota. 3. Set their job at each venue separately if they do different work at each. (From: Giving somebody shifts at two venues)
I have read that already and it does not cover it. No clash warning.
I cannot do that one from here. Passing you to the desk now.
Hi, Farah here from the desk. I can see the chat. That is one for the billing team; I have raised it and you will get an email today.
Done. Thanks.
hiya, two new people have not had their invitation emails and they start Monday.

Try this: 1. Open Settings > Billing and fill in the company name, address and VAT number. 2. Save, then download the invoice you need. 3. Older invoices can be rebuilt with the new details from the same list. (From: Getting a VAT invoice)
No, that page is about something else. Invite not received.

Let me try again: We get asked about an invitation that never arrived in two or three different ways. The answer below is the one that suits most venues, and the note at the end covers the rest. (From: An invitation that never arrived)
Is there someone on the desk I can talk to?
I am not finding a page that covers that. I will pass this to the desk and somebody will pick it up here.
Hi, Yasmin here from the desk. I can see the chat. It is a known problem with the latest app version, an update is on the way; use the website until then.

From the help centre: 1. Open Settings > Billing and fill in the company name, address and VAT number. 2. Save, then download the invoice you need. 3. Older invoices can be rebuilt with the new details from the same list. (From: Getting a VAT invoice)

Hi, holiday requests from the cafe staff are coming to me and they should be going to the cafe manager.

From the help centre: 1. Open the staff record and change Permission from Staff to Manager. 2. Tick which venues they manage. 3. Save; they see the manager screens the next time they sign in. (From: Making somebody a manager)
Done. Thanks.
Quick one, the wage cost report has no takings against it since Saturday.

Try this: 1. Open Settings > Connections and then the transfer log. 2. Click the red line; the error is written out in full underneath. 3. Fix what it names, then press Send again against that run. (From: Reading a transfer error)
Yes that is it, thank you.
Hi, three of the team cannot get into the app. It says the email or password is wrong and they are sure it is not.

From the help centre: 1. Install the app on the new phone and sign in as usual. 2. Allow notifications again; the new phone asks on its own. 3. Sign out on the old phone, or ask your manager to take it off your account. (From: Signing in on a new phone)
Done. Thanks.
hi there, everybody's half hour break is still in their total. I thought unpaid breaks came off automatically.

Try this: 1. Set whether breaks are paid or unpaid for the venue under Settings > Rotas. 2. An unpaid break comes off both the rota'd hours and the worked hours. 3. A paid break is left in both, and the hours read the same as the shift length. (From: Unpaid breaks and how they come off the total)
Yes that is it, thank you.
Quick one, nothing has gone through to payroll since the end of last month and nobody told us.

This should sort it: Managers ask us about the nightly transfer and when it runs more than almost anything else, so here it is in full. You will find it under Settings > Connections. (From: The nightly transfer and when it runs)
Sorted, cheers.
hi there, i have built next week's rota and when I press publish nothing happens. The staff say they still cannot see it on their phones.

This should sort it: 1. Everybody with a shift that week is told when you first publish. 2. After that, only the people whose own shifts changed are told. 3. Managers at that venue get a copy of every change, whoever made it. (From: Who is told when a rota changes)
That worked, thanks.
Help, i have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me.
This should sort it: Short answer on setting up the payroll connection: it is all at Settings > Connections, and the steps below take you through it. (From: Setting up the payroll connection)

Hello, the password page says the invitation has expired but I only sent it last week.

This should sort it: 1. Open Settings > API and press New key. 2. Copy it before you close the window; it is not shown again. 3. Put the new key into whatever uses it, then press Revoke on the old one. (From: Changing an API key)
I have read that already and it does not cover it. Cannot set his password.

Sorry about that. Here is a different page that may fit better: Short answer on sending an invitation again: it is all at Staff, and the steps below take you through it. (From: Sending an invitation again)

Done. Thanks.
hiya, the hours report says one hundred and ninety two and I have added the rota up at one hundred and eighty six. Which one goes to payroll?

From the help centre: 1. Open Hours and pick the week you are paying. 2. Work down the flags: open shifts, big differences and anything corrected. 3. Press Approve week when the totals look right. (From: Approving the week's hours)
hi there, the app shows this week but nothing for next, and the rota is definitely published.

From the help centre: 1. Enter the email address on your staff record, not a personal one you have not told us about. 2. Enter the password you set when you accepted your invitation. 3. Tap Forgotten password if you have never set one. (From: Signing in to the app)
hiya, we need to change the API key our reporting uses. What happens to the old one?

Try this: 1. Open Settings > API and press New key. 2. Copy it before you close the window; it is not shown again. 3. Put the new key into whatever uses it, then press Revoke on the old one. (From: Changing an API key)
No, that page is about something else. New api key.
I am sorry about that. Let me get a person for you.
Hi, Oona here from the desk. I can see the chat. I have done it from this end, you should see it now.
Sorted, cheers.
hiya, this month's bill counts thirty one people and we only have twenty six.

Try this: 1. Every line names the month it covers and the number of staff it counted. 2. Part months from a plan change show as their own line with the dates on them. 3. Compare the line against the invoice of the same date under Invoices. (From: Reading the charges on your statement)
Yes that is it, thank you.
hi there, we have decided to go with another system from February. How do I close the account so the card is not charged?

Try this: 1. Open Settings > Billing > Invoices. 2. Every month is listed with the date, the amount and the staff count it was based on. 3. Press the arrow at the end of a line to download it as a PDF. (From: Where to find your invoices)
Done. Thanks.
hiya, i have published next week but one of the chefs says his app is empty.
From the help centre: This page covers reconnecting something that stopped from start to finish. It lives under Settings > Connections. (From: Reconnecting something that stopped)
No, that page is about something else. Chef cannot see his shifts.

Sorry about that. Here is a different page that may fit better: 1. Finish the week, then press Publish at the top right of the rota. 2. The summary tells you how many shifts are going out and to how many people. 3. Confirm it, and everybody with a shift that week gets an email and a push notification. 4. The week's heading turns from Draft to Published once it has gone. (From: Publishing a rota so staff can see it)
Done. Thanks.
Quick one, somebody booked the bank holiday Monday off and it has taken a whole day off her allowance. She does not normally work Mondays.

This should sort it: 1. Set which bank holidays your venue observes under Settings > Rotas. 2. Observed days show shaded on the rota so nobody builds a normal week by accident. 3. Rota staff on as usual if you are trading; the shading is a reminder, not a block. (From: Bank holidays on the rota)
Done. Thanks.
hiya, there is a holiday request sat in my list and the approve button does nothing when I press it.

From the help centre: 1. Open Settings > Plan and press Close account at the foot of the page. 2. Type the venue name to confirm you mean it. 3. Export anything you want to keep before the date it closes. (From: Closing an account)

Try this: 1. Click the shift and use the Break box to enter the length in minutes. 2. Tick Unpaid if the break comes off what the shift is worth. 3. Leave the start time of the break blank unless your venue fixes it. (From: Putting a break on a shift)

This should sort it: 1. Open Hours > Payroll and press Lock against the period once payroll has gone. 2. Locked weeks cannot be reopened, corrected or rebuilt. 3. Only the owner can unlock one, and it goes on the account history when they do. (From: Locking a pay period)

Done. Thanks.
